Scottie Barnes (Out): Barnes (groin) is out for Thursday's game against Philadelphia.

Ajay Mitchell (Out): Mitchell (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

Xavier Legette (Injured Reserve): Legette (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at New Orleans.
